csv_project_name: Design for Asheville Regional Airport Design
csv_scope_of_work: Authority, is seeking proposals from qualified experienced firms (Respondents) to submit proposals (Proposal) desiring to design, construct, finance, market, operate and maintain Fixed Base Operator (FBO) facilities, aircraft hangars, Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) Operator facilities, and/or other aeronautical facilities at the Asheville Regional Airport (Airport or AVL).
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering
title: Design for Asheville Regional Airport
short_description: Airport seeks teams for FBO, hangar, MRO, and other aeronautical facility development.
project_scope: Design, construct, finance, market, operate, and maintain Fixed Base Operator facilities, aircraft hangars, Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul operator facilities, and other aeronautical facilities at Asheville Regional Airport. No technical dimensions, spans, areas, or capacities are stated.
services: Integrated delivery/development services including design, construction, financing, marketing, operation, and maintenance; requested disciplines include interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, and civil engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Airport facilities and hangars can involve interesting long-span structures, which is generally relevant to sbp.
- However, the notice is broad and primarily seeks a developer/operator team rather than clearly defined structural design services.
- No specific structural complexity, span, roof system, or innovative lightweight construction is described.
- Includes significant non-design components such as finance, marketing, operation, and maintenance, reducing direct fit.
- Could be strategically interesting only if hangar or MRO buildings develop into architecturally or structurally demanding projects.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The project includes FBO facilities, aircraft hangars, MRO facilities, and other aeronautical facilities, but no sizes, quantities, phasing, or budget information are provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible from the available text.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. Because the scope is a broad design-build-finance-operate-maintain solicitation without defined planning packages, service phases, or construction budget, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived.
references_qualifications: Qualified and experienced firms are sought; no specific reference counts, project types, fee zones, or minimum qualifications are stated.
contracting_authority: Greater Asheville Regional Airport Authority, Fletcher, North Carolina, USA. Phone: 828-684-2226.
notes: Target market: Transportation. County: Buncombe. State: North Carolina. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Solicitation documents available by contact. No submission deadline set. Source project numbers: Project #858230-1; AgencyID 88627; ProjectID 1009804; DR #202600026262.
